variants.headline: Looking back: colony openly defies its charter
variants.sub: Open defiance of the charter is taking place in {colony}.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The colony was openly defying its charter.

Political principle is tested when obedience and conviction are said to pull apart. Our movement should be able to explain its judgment of authority rather than treating either compliance or defiance as automatically virtuous. A serious argument concerns legitimacy and responsibility, not the appeal of a defiant gesture alone.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The position of {target} warrants scrutiny through the reported defiance. This account does not presume the precise breach or announce a punitive consequence that has not been established in the report.
